t: You're on Dean Street, in the heart of Soho. It runs south from Oxford Street down to Shaftesbury Avenue, crossing Old Compton Street on the way, and it's linked to Frith Street by Bateman Street. Two people from the past are tied to the street. John Swaine, an English draughtsman and engraver, died here. John Edy, a London maker of instruments and trusses, lived here. The material I have says little more about either of them, so I'll leave it there and let you enjoy the street.
